resources.string: Tether runs a coding agent on this device. Your projects and your model keys stay here.
Stored only on this phone. Used as the author of commits.
Any one provider is enough. The key is kept in the Android Keystore and leaves this phone only in requests to that provider.
Saved on this phone, then tested with the provider.
This key was not accepted. Paste it again, or create a new key with the provider.
Checking the key with the provider.
The provider accepted this key. Next, open a project.
A project is a code repository stored on this phone. The agent can only touch files inside it.
Clone a repository you can reach with GitHub sign-in.
Unpack a ZIP into a new project.
Replays the setup: your name, a provider key, and a project.
